instruction: Export the open Impress presentation to a JPEG image file and save it as output.jpg on the Desktop. Apply default export settings.

metadata.explanation: Checks if the exported JPEG file exists and has a minimum size of 10KB. JPEG is an alternative image export format supported by LibreOffice Impress. Verified: Similar export task with different output format.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly checks file existence at the specified path (/home/user/Desktop/output.jpg)
Getter properly uses get_vm_file to retrieve file from VM environment with appropriate error handling
Metric correctly validates both file existence (50% score) and minimum size requirement (50% score)
Expected value of 10KB minimum size is reasonable for a JPEG export from a presentation
Postconfig includes sleep(1.0) for file system sync after export
Logic will work correctly at runtime - file existence + size check provides practical verification
Minor limitation: Does not verify file format (JPEG magic bytes or extension validation) or content validity
Minor limitation: Cannot verify export source (could be any file named output.jpg), but file creation timing makes this unlikely
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Consider adding file extension validation (.jpg or .jpeg) in the getter or metric
Consider checking JPEG magic bytes (FF D8 FF) to verify file format validity
Consider adjusting minimum size based on presentation complexity, though 10KB is a reasonable heuristic
